$description: How a Recanica page is built: for each page type, its regions in reading order and the part that fills each region. Single source for the docs (/docs/page-anatomy), the recanica-page skill and AI tools. A page that needs a region not listed here needs a brief, and maybe a new part.
thinking: 1. Purpose: what is the page for, who arrives, what's the one main action.
2. Page type: pick the closest type below. It fixes the shell and the region order.
3. Regions: fill each region with its part, in order. Skip regions the page doesn't need; don't invent new ones.
4. Content: put real content in each part (longest and shortest cases).
5. Look: render at 375px and 1280px; check reader order, shared edges, one primary action.
6. Measure: recanica review (85+), audit (0 must-fix), check (0 must-fix).

types.use: Daily landing page of an app: status at a glance, what needs attention.

regions.note: Title, one-line description, at most one primary action
3–4 stats in one surface, hairline dividers
5–8 rows, 'View all' link in the section actions

types.use: Find, filter and act on many items.

regions.note: Only numbers that change what you do next
One row; wraps as a group
4–6 columns; hide secondary columns below md; never hide the last

types.use: One record: its state, its facts, what you can do with it.

regions.note: Primary action for the record's next step
Main content left; key facts and secondary actions in the aside
One section per question the reader asks

types.use: Enter or change one thing, then save.

regions.note: No actions here; the save is at the end
One column; 10+ fields → titled sections or steps
Verb that says what happens: 'Send invoice'

types.use: Change how the account behaves, a group at a time.

regions.part: Section per group (title + description left, fields right on desktop)
regions.note: Each group saves on its own

types.use: One focused task with nothing around it.
Review and pay, with the total always visible.
Explain one product to someone deciding.
Read one piece end to end.
Look things up; scan, then read one part.
types.shell: TopBar + docs nav + Page width="reading" + table of contents

regions.note: No eyebrow; the nav shows where you are
